implementation_evidence.automatic_start: Authenticated packaged login starts a non-blocking daemon uploader and stops it on application exit.
implementation_evidence.privacy_boundary: A strict extra-forbid wire contract accepts only opaque IDs, versions, stable codes, bounded aggregate statistics, transitions, and timestamps; polluted legacy rows are quarantined before any request.
implementation_evidence.authentication: The client sends the current tenant Bearer token; the API binds every batch to the token's tenant and client installation and requires upload capability.
implementation_evidence.offline_recovery: Failures requeue durable events without changing the local validation audit; retry intervals back off from 30 seconds to a 300-second cap and restart recovery requeues interrupted uploads.
implementation_evidence.server_acknowledgement: The seed API returns strict event acknowledgements only after immutable private persistence; duplicate events remain idempotent across repository reopen.
implementation_evidence.storage_privacy: Persisted telemetry files use mode 0600 and tests assert the absence of customer identity field names.
